# MapanSetu Certificate FAQ (TEST/DEMO MATERIAL)

## How do I verify a certificate?
You can verify any MapanSetu certificate by visiting the public verification portal and entering the unique certificate ID. Alternatively, scan the QR code printed on the physical certificate.

## What if my certificate is rejected?
If an application is rejected, you will receive a notification outlining the reasons. You can rectify the issues and submit a re-application within 15 days.
